PURPOSE: Provide one serializable repair pattern for active-integration cutover races and shard-universe split-brain findings without claiming that V16-RC1.3 text has already changed.

CAS_A_ENTRY_RESERVATION.RATIONALE: Closing integration admission and reserving the one global transition occurs before identity cutover, so no new integration can race into the drain window while an already-issued old-identity Git side effect remains representable.

RULES: If ACTIVE_INTEGRATION==null and INTEGRATION_HEALTH==HEALTHY, mark OLD_INTEGRATION_RECONCILED without inventing work.
If an integration exists, only transition-authorized reconciliation/recovery may advance it; unrelated integration stays forbidden.
RESERVED or REF_UPDATE_PENDING may abort only if no external ref update was issued and durable evidence proves that fact.
REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS must read actual target HEAD and classify exactly per clauses [144]-[145].
HEAD==EXPECTED -> NOT_COMMITTED path; HEAD==CANDIDATE -> COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION; any other HEAD -> BLOCKED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION must finish exact bound verification before clearing ACTIVE_INTEGRATION.
REGRESSION/ROLLBACK_PENDING/FORWARD_FIX_PENDING must complete authorized recovery with expected-head semantics before clearing ACTIVE_INTEGRATION.
UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION can never be cleared by timeout, assumption, or epoch invalidation.
The old law/spec/mission identity remains the semantic authority for interpreting and reconciling the already-existing integration until it becomes terminal.
OLD_INTEGRATION_DRAIN.EXIT: ACTIVE_INTEGRATION==null AND INTEGRATION_HEALTH==HEALTHY AND actual target HEAD/TREE are explicitly bound into transition evidence

PRECONDITIONS: ACTIVE_TRANSITION_ID and intent hash still match
actual target HEAD/TREE equal transition drain evidence
ATOMIC_WRITES_COMMON: install only the requested new global identity/descriptor
TRANSITION_SPECIFIC: CONSTITUTION_ACTIVATION installs new EFFECTIVE_CONSTITUTION_HASH + activation generation/state.
SPEC_ACTIVATION installs new SPEC_ARTIFACT_HASH + activation generation/state and binds rebuilt root-generation intent.
MISSION_ROTATION installs ACTIVE_MISSION_ID and exactly OLD_GENERATION+1.
SHARD_UNIVERSE_UPDATE installs new SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION only after migration verification described below.
CAS_B_IDENTITY_CUTOVER.GATES: Remain closed through post-cutover validation; reopening requires a later expected-version CAS after all transition-specific validation passes.

CRASH_RECOVERY: Before CAS_A: no transition authority exists.
After CAS_A/before drain: resume by transition ID; gates remain closed.
During Git truth reconciliation: actual target ref is product truth and ambiguity blocks cutover.
After drain/before CAS_B: revalidate target HEAD/TREE and STATE_VERSION; any movement blocks/restarts reconciliation.
After CAS_B: new identity is installed but gates remain closed until post-cutover validation.
USER_STOP may preempt any phase but must preserve active integration, Git result, transition ID, and reconciliation evidence.

MIGRATION_RULES: CAS_A closes normal writers before authoritative migration begins.
All old-universe records are enumerated by immutable record ID from pinned source roots.
Each record is mapped exactly once to a new logical shard using the bound mapping algorithm.
Every new shard emits an explicit manifest, including empty shards.
Per-domain migration manifests prove source_count==destination_count, unique source IDs, unique destination IDs, and identical record-content hashes.
Any missing, duplicate, conflicting, or unparseable record blocks CUTOVER_READY.
No dual-write protocol is assumed. V1 repair uses freeze/drain/migrate/cutover for simpler linearizability.
CAS_B increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH and installs U2 only after all domain migration roots independently verify.
Old U1 shard namespaces become read-only historical evidence after CAS_B.
Every active participant must renew membership in the new MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH before normal mutation.
Closure entry is forbidden while SHARD_UNIVERSE_UPDATE is nonterminal.
LEASE_AND_REVALIDATION_DELTA: Lease binding adds SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH and SHARD_UNIVERSE_VERSION.
Pre-mutation revalidation adds SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH and SHARD_UNIVERSE_VERSION.
Membership record adds SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH and SHARD_UNIVERSE_VERSION for active mutation eligibility.

TORTURE_TEST_MATRIX: For each of RESERVED, REF_UPDATE_PENDING, REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS, COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED, REGRESSION, ROLLBACK_PENDING, FORWARD_FIX_PENDING, UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION: race transition CAS_A before/after phase change.
Crash immediately before and after Git ref CAS, before and after CAS_A, and before and after CAS_B.
Attempt new integration reservation after CAS_A and require deterministic rejection.
Change target HEAD between drain evidence and CAS_B and require cutover rejection.
For shard migration: crash after each domain/shard manifest, duplicate one record, omit one record, omit one empty shard, inject stale U1 writer, and require fail-closed behavior.
USER_STOP at every transition phase preserves durable Git/integration truth.
ADOPTION_REQUIREMENTS: Explicit user law change or a higher-authority normative Constitution revision must adopt equivalent rules; this proposal cannot amend immutable V16-RC1.3 by itself.
Exact adopted law bytes must be pinned and hashed.
Independent static review must prove the repaired ordering closes all four referenced findings or explicitly leave residual blockers.
Executable torture tests must pass before product mutation activation.
NON_CLAIMS: This proposal is not an active Constitution amendment.
It does not close any referenced finding.
It performs no product source mutation or target integration.
